buxton_h1_0.text: Ey up, duck! That is how we say hello round here. 'Duck' means dear, and it is a compliment.
Folk argue about Bakewell tart. Over in Bakewell they will tell you the real thing is a pudding.

then.text: Another slice? Your eyes are bigger than the tin. Off you go.

else.text: Have a slice of the tart. I will not tell Bakewell.
